programs.title: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries: Blessings in Disguise
programs.desc: After Cheryl's three-year engagement ends in a devastating breakup, her life is turned upside down when her aunt offers her an escape from Chicago to the Amish town of Sugarcreek. As Cheryl begins to solve the mystery, she finds community, belonging and the potential of new love.
